We methodically annotated 50 (instruction, API sequence) pairs from each of the training sets of Tool-Bench and ToolAlpaca, as well as a large portion of the Tool-Bench test set (∼700 instances). Each of the criteria is marked either as valid or invalid for each of the annotated instances.
